keySentence: Long John seemed kind but Jim slowly found his true nature.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Silver was planning something bad! Jim told the captain about it. Now they had to be careful. Long John seemed kind but Jim slowly found his true nature.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim discovered that Silver and some sailors were planning a mutiny. They wanted to steal all the treasure for themselves! Jim was shocked because he had trusted Silver. He bravely ran to the captain and told him everything. Long John seemed kind but Jim slowly found his true nature. Now the ship was divided between good people and pirates.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Jim could barely believe what he had heard — Silver was the leader of a pirate mutiny! The friendly cook had been secretly recruiting sailors to turn against the captain. Their plan was to wait until the treasure was found and then take everything. Jim felt betrayed because he had genuinely cared about Silver. Long John seemed kind but Jim slowly found his true nature. However, Jim knew that staying silent would put everyone in danger. Because telling the truth was the right thing to do, Jim rushed to inform the captain. From that moment on, every person on the ship had to choose a side.
